name: es30-multisample-default-framebuffer
title: Multisampled default framebuffer
summary: A 4-sample default framebuffer (EGL config): SAMPLE_BUFFERS / SAMPLES follow the draw framebuffer; an anti-aliased rotating cube with equal-channel-sum face colors. Asserted without assuming how samples are combined: per-sample stencil counts and occlusion queries on the window (no sample covered twice, no crack inside the silhouette, nothing outside it, with positive controls), the fully specified single-sample control (exact faces, crack-free seams, no blends), glReadPixels allowed on the default framebuffer, identical-bounds sub-rectangle and doubly mirrored resolves equal to the whole resolve, and the INVALID_OPERATION cases of ES 3.0 4.3.2 and 4.3.3. The resolved colors of the window and of the blit (bounds, seam sums, blends, coverage area) are implementation-dependent and only printed.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.3 Multisampling (multisample buffer of the window-system framebuffer, SAMPLE_BUFFERS, SAMPLES, sample points possibly outside the pixel)
ES 3.0 §3.6.1 Basic Polygon Rasterization (point sampling, shared edges, CullFace / FrontFace), §3.6.3 Polygon Multisample Rasterization
ES 3.0 §4.1.10 Additional Multisample Fragment Operations (per-sample stencil test and operations; sample values combined into the color buffer, "The method of combination is not specified")
ES 3.0 §4.3.2 Reading Pixels (INVALID_OPERATION only when READ_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING is non-zero and SAMPLE_BUFFERS is one)
ES 3.0 §4.3.3 Copying Pixels (resolve; identical formats and bounds; multisample draw framebuffer; mirroring of both rectangles)
ES 3.0 §4.4.2.1 Renderbuffer Objects (RENDERBUFFER_SAMPLES >= samples), §4.4.4.2 Whole Framebuffer Completeness (SAMPLE_BUFFERS / SAMPLES of framebuffer objects)
ES 3.0 §6.1.13 Framebuffer Object Queries (default framebuffer BACK attachment: sizes, component type, color encoding)
ES 3.0 Appendix B corollary 8 (no pixel dropouts or duplicates along shared edges)
ES 3.2 §13.4 Multisampling (glGetMultisamplefv: positions in [0, 1], INVALID_VALUE for index >= SAMPLES; ES 3.1+ contexts only)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.9 Interpolation (flat), §4.5.4 Default Precision Qualifiers
ES 3.0 §4.1.4 Stencil Test, §4.1.5 Depth Buffer Test, §4.1.6 Occlusion Queries (ANY_SAMPLES_PASSED per sample)
ES 3.0 §2.5 GL Errors (an erroneous command has no effect), Appendix A.1 Repeatability

api.glGetIntegerv: SAMPLE_BUFFERS = 1 / SAMPLES >= 1 for the default framebuffer, 0 / 0 for a single-sample FBO, 1 / >= 4 for a 4-sample FBO, restored after rebinding 0; READ_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING 0, READ_BUFFER BACK, SUBPIXEL_BITS printed
api.glGetFramebufferAttachmentParameteriv: DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER 0, BACK: RED/GREEN/BLUE/ALPHA_SIZE 8, COMPONENT_TYPE UNSIGNED_NORMALIZED, COLOR_ENCODING LINEAR (the resolve target format); STENCIL: STENCIL_SIZE >= 2 decides whether the per-sample stencil checks run
api.glGetMultisamplefv: ES 3.1+ contexts only: SAMPLE_POSITION for every index < SAMPLES lies in [0, 1]^2; index = SAMPLES -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glReadPixels: from the multisampled default framebuffer: no error (READ_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING 0, READ_BUFFER BACK), the image unchanged by a rejected blit into the window; the resolved values are only observed; from a complete 4-sample FBO -> INVALID_OPERATION; the single-sample control FBO read back and checked per pixel against the CPU projection
api.glBlitFramebuffer: default framebuffer -> RGBA8 FBO with identical rectangles: no error; identical-bounds sub-rectangle writes only that rectangle and equals the whole resolve there; both rectangles mirrored: accepted and equal to the whole resolve (not mirrored); INVALID_OPERATION with nothing copied for translated, scaled and destination-only-mirrored rectangles, into RGB565, and into the multisampled default framebuffer (window unchanged); resolved values only observed
api.glBindFramebuffer: READ_FRAMEBUFFER and DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER set separately for every resolve and error case; FRAMEBUFFER for rendering the control
api.glGenFramebuffers: RGBA8, RGB565 and 4-sample framebuffers used by the checks
api.glFramebufferRenderbuffer: color attachment of the three FBOs; complete, read back or used as blit targets
api.glRenderbufferStorage: RGBA8 (control and resolve target, read back) and RGB565 (format-mismatch error) at surface size
api.glRenderbufferStorageMultisample: 4-sample RGBA8: SAMPLE_BUFFERS 1 / SAMPLES >= 4 as draw framebuffer; glReadPixels from it is INVALID_OPERATION
api.glDrawArrays: 36-vertex cube: the single-sample control matches the CPU projection exactly, its samples in the window are counted per sample with stencil INCR; TRIANGLE_FAN probing polygons (inset / grown silhouette, full screen)
api.glEnable: CULL_FACE: only the CPU-predicted front faces appear; STENCIL_TEST and DEPTH_TEST (ALWAYS) for the per-sample counts on the window
api.glCullFace: BACK: hidden faces removed (face pixels match the visible faces only)
api.glFrontFace: CCW: the faces counter-clockwise in window coordinates are the visible ones
api.glDisable: DITHER during the demo (re-enabled in shutdown)
api.glClearColor: background and magenta sentinel, observed exactly in the read-back images
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT of the window and the FBOs; STENCIL_BUFFER_BIT of the window before each per-sample count
api.glViewport: full-surface viewport used by the CPU projection
api.glUniformMatrix4fv: u_mvp: the rendered cube matches the CPU projection with the same matrix
api.glBufferData: 36 vertices with position and face color, observed in the images
api.glVertexAttribPointer: interleaved position (3 floats) and color (4 floats)
api.glStencilFunc: LESS 1 / EQUAL 0 / NOTEQUAL 0 probes inside ANY_SAMPLES_PASSED queries (FALSE where required, TRUE in the positive controls)
api.glStencilOp: INCR counts the front faces covering each window sample (drawing the cube twice is the positive control); ZERO clears the grown silhouette
api.glColorMask: color writes off during the per-sample stencil passes on the window
api.glDepthFunc: ALWAYS during the per-sample counts, so every sample passes the depth test the query and dppass refer to
api.glBeginQuery: ANY_SAMPLES_PASSED around every stencil probe of the window: FALSE for the three per-sample checks, TRUE for the positive controls
api.glGetQueryObjectuiv: QUERY_RESULT of every probe (both outcomes required by different checks)
api.glGenQueries: the query object of the stencil probes

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture viewed: a cube on a dark navy background showing three flat faces (violet top, green left, cyan right), centred, about half the window wide. A 6x enlargement of the top-left corner shows one-pixel blended steps along the silhouette and along the violet/green seam, with no stair-stepping, cracks or stray pixels. The 333x777 capture shows the same cube centred in the tall window, at the same size relative to the narrow side and not stretched. llvmpipe and zink produce no capture (BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT, 0x0 multisampled pbuffer).
